title: A CH obstruction to a prescribed categoricity threshold
summary: Assuming the continuum hypothesis, we construct an abstract elementary class with Löwenheim–Skolem number ℵ 0 that is categorical in every sufficiently large cardinal but has at least two nonisomorphic models of cardinality $`\beth_{\omega_2}`$. Thus categoricity does not transfer down to the proposed bound $`\beth_{(2^{\aleph_0})^+}`$, which equals $`\beth_{\omega_2}`$ under CH. Consequently, if ZFC is consistent, the prescribed-threshold form of Shelah's categoricity conjecture is not provable in ZFC.
family_title: Shelah's eventual categoricity and the prescribed-threshold obstruction

review.reason: Under CH, builds an abstract elementary class showing a categoricity threshold cannot be proven in ZFC.
